P-CONNECT.en: Draw a line to each match.

P-DRAG.en: Drag each picture to its match.

P-SORT.en: Drag each into the right basket.

P-ORDER.en: Drag them into the right order.

FB-GEM.id: Permata ini masuk ke Kotak Permatamu.
FB-GEM.en: This gem goes into your Gem box.

body.id: Keluarga saling menyayangi. Setiap keluarga berbeda, dan semuanya keluarga.
body.en: Families love and look after each other. Every family is different, and all are families.

body.id: Orang tua ayah dan ibu: kakek dan nenek. Saudara lebih tua: kakak; lebih muda: adik.
body.en: Your parents' parents: kakek and nenek. Older sibling: kakak; younger: adik.

body.id: Aturan rumah membuat semua nyaman. Kamu juga bisa membantu.
body.en: Home rules help everyone feel comfortable. You can help too.

body.id: Guru mengajar, petugas UKS merawat, satpam menjaga, petugas kebersihan membersihkan.
body.en: Teachers teach, UKS staff care for us, guards keep us safe, cleaners keep school clean.

body.id: Tetangga yang baik saling menyapa dan menolong.
body.en: Good neighbours greet and help each other.

body.id: Gotong royong: bekerja bersama, seperti kerja bakti. Anak-anak bisa membantu dengan aman.
body.en: Gotong royong: working together, like a clean-up day. Children can help safely.

body.id: Peta = gambar suatu tempat dilihat dari atas, seperti mata burung.
body.en: A map shows a place from above, the way a bird sees it.

body.id: Kiri, kanan, atas, bawah, dekat, jauh. Berhadapan? Tangan kanan temanmu di sisi kirimu.
body.en: Left, right, above, below, near, far. Facing a friend? Their right hand is on your left.

body.id: Simbol peta: kotak = rumah, dua garis = jalan, garis biru = sungai.
body.en: Map symbols: box = house, two lines = road, blue line = river.

body.id: Warna primer: merah, kuning, biru. Putih membuat warna lebih muda.
body.en: Primary colours: red, yellow, blue. White makes a colour lighter.

body.id: Merah + kuning = jingga, kuning + biru = hijau, merah + biru = ungu.
body.en: Red + yellow = orange, yellow + blue = green, red + blue = purple.

body.id: Bentuk sederhana bisa menjadi gambar: matahari, rumah, layang-layang.
body.en: Simple shapes make pictures: a sun, a house, a kite.

body.id: Bunyi bisa keras (guntur) atau pelan (bisikan). Jaga telingamu.
body.en: Sounds can be loud (thunder) or soft (a whisper). Look after your ears.

body.id: Bunyi juga bisa cepat atau lambat. Lagu pengantar tidur itu lambat.
body.en: Sounds can be fast or slow, too. A lullaby is slow.

body.id: Irama: pola bunyi dan diam, misalnya tepuk – tepuk – diam.
body.en: Rhythm: a pattern of sound and silence, like clap – clap – rest.

body.id: Sore itu Nenek pulang dari pasar. Tangannya penuh tas belanjaan.
body.en: One afternoon Grandma comes home from the market. Her hands are full of shopping bags.

body.id: Raka sedang asyik menonton kartun di ruang tengah.
body.en: Raka is busy watching cartoons in the living room.

body.id: Sudah pukul sembilan malam. Doni ingin bermain gendang keras-keras.
body.en: It's nine o'clock at night. Doni wants to play his drum really loudly.

body.id: Di sebelah rumah, bayi Bu Wati baru saja tertidur.
body.en: Next door, Bu Wati's baby has just fallen asleep.

body.id: Anak-anak kelas 2 berlatih musik. Ada yang memegang kentongan bambu, ada yang memegang botol berisi beras.
body.en: Class 2 is practising music. Some children hold bamboo kentongan, and some hold bottles filled with rice.

body.id: Bu Guru berkata, "Kalau tanganku terangkat tinggi, mainkan dengan keras. Kalau tanganku turun rendah, mainkan dengan pelan."
body.en: The teacher says, "When my hand is up high, play loudly. When my hand is down low, play softly."

meaning.id: Mana Kakek? (ayah dari ayah atau ibumu)
meaning.en: Which is Grandfather? (your dad's or mum's father)

model_answer.id: Kakek adalah ayah dari ayah atau ibu kita.
model_answer.en: Grandfather is our dad's or our mum's father.

meaning.id: Arti → panggilannya.
meaning.en: Meaning → family word.

model_answer.id: Kakak lebih tua, adik lebih muda, nenek ibu orang tuamu, paman saudara laki-laki orang tuamu.
model_answer.en: Kakak is older, adik is younger, Grandmother is your parent's mother, Uncle is your parent's brother.

meaning.id: Dita tinggal dengan Nenek, Ibu, dan 2 adik. Berapa orang, termasuk Dita?
meaning.en: Dita lives with Grandma, Mum and 2 younger siblings. How many people, counting Dita?

model_answer.id: Nenek, Ibu, dua adik, dan Dita sendiri: 5 orang.
model_answer.en: Grandmother, Mum, two younger siblings and Dita herself: 5 people.

meaning.id: Setiap keluarga pasti terdiri atas ayah, ibu, dan anak.
meaning.en: Every family is always a dad, a mum and children.

model_answer.id: Keluarga berbeda-beda: ada yang dengan ibu saja, ayah saja, atau kakek-nenek. Yang penting saling menyayangi.
model_answer.en: Families differ: some live with just Mum, just Dad or grandparents. What matters is caring for each other.

meaning.id: Siapa yang paling muda?
meaning.en: Who is the youngest?

model_answer.id: Adik bayi adalah anggota keluarga yang paling muda.
model_answer.en: The baby is the youngest in the family.

meaning.id: Dari yang paling tua.
meaning.en: Oldest first.

model_answer.id: Kakek, Ibu, Kakak, lalu Adik bayi.
model_answer.en: Grandfather, Mum, big brother or sister, then the baby.

meaning.id: Aku bisa bantu, atau tugas orang dewasa?
meaning.en: Can I help, or is it a grown-up job?

model_answer.id: Kamu bisa merapikan mainan, menyiram tanaman, membawa piring. Kompor dan pisau tajam untuk orang dewasa.
model_answer.en: You can tidy toys, water plants and carry plates. The stove and sharp knives are for grown-ups.

meaning.id: Apa yang sebaiknya Raka lakukan?
meaning.en: What would be a kind thing for Raka to do?

text.en: Keep watching until the cartoon ends
Ask whether Grandma bought him a snack

text.id: Berhenti sebentar dan membantu Nenek membawa tas yang ringan
text.en: Pause and help Grandma carry a light bag

model_answer.id: Raka bisa berhenti sebentar dan membantu Nenek. Kartunnya bisa ditonton lagi nanti.
model_answer.en: Raka can pause for a moment and help Grandma. The cartoon can wait.

meaning.id: Aturan → alasannya.
meaning.en: Rule → its reason.

text.en: Say where you're going before you go out

text.id: Supaya kuman tidak masuk ke mulut
text.en: So germs don't get into your mouth

text.id: Supaya keluarga tahu kamu di mana
text.en: So your family knows where you are

model_answer.id: Cuci tangan: kuman tidak masuk. Rapikan mainan: tidak ada yang tersandung. Pamit: keluarga tahu kamu di mana.
model_answer.en: Wash hands: no germs in. Tidy toys: nobody trips. Say where you go: family knows where you are.

meaning.id: Aturan Sari: tidur pukul delapan malam. Mengapa?
meaning.en: Sari's rule: bed at eight o'clock. Why?

text.en: So she needn't brush her teeth
So she can never play again

text.id: Supaya cukup istirahat dan segar besok
text.en: So she rests and feels fresh tomorrow

model_answer.id: Aturan jam tidur membantu Sari cukup istirahat dan segar untuk sekolah besok.
model_answer.en: A bedtime rule helps Sari get enough rest and feel fresh for school tomorrow.

meaning.id: Anak-anak juga boleh ikut membicarakan aturan rumah bersama keluarga.
meaning.en: Children can also join in talking about home rules with their family.

model_answer.id: Aturan rumah bisa dibicarakan bersama. Kamu boleh menyampaikan pendapatmu dengan sopan.
model_answer.en: Home rules can be talked over together. You can share your ideas politely.

model_answer.id: Gambar pohon keluargamu! Tulis nama orang yang tinggal bersamamu atau yang kamu sayangi, lalu hias sesukamu. Setiap pohon keluarga berbeda, dan semuanya indah.
model_answer.en: Draw your family tree! Write the names of the people you live with or love, then decorate it however you like. Every family tree is different, and every one is lovely.

meaning.id: Mana Nenek? (ibu dari ayah atau ibumu)
meaning.en: Which is Grandmother? (your dad's or mum's mother)

model_answer.id: Nenek adalah ibu dari ayah atau ibu kita.
model_answer.en: Grandmother is our dad's or our mum's mother.

meaning.id: Aturan Bima: habis makan, piring dibawa ke tempat cuci. Bima melakukan apa?
meaning.en: Bima's rule: after eating, plates go to the sink. What does Bima do?

text.en: Takes his plate to the sink
Leaves his plate on the table
Hides his plate under a chair

model_answer.id: Bima membawa piringnya ke tempat cuci: ikut aturan sekaligus membantu.
model_answer.en: Bima takes his plate to the sink: following the rule and helping.

model_answer.id: Congklak, yang sering dimainkan bersama kakak, adik, atau nenek, termasuk keluarga permainan "mancala". Permainan sejenis, dengan lubang dan biji, sudah dimainkan berabad-abad di Afrika, Asia, dan Timur Tengah dengan nama yang berbeda-beda.
model_answer.en: Congklak, often played with brothers, sisters or grandparents, belongs to the "mancala" family of games. Games like it, with pits and seeds, have been played for centuries across Africa, Asia and the Middle East under many different names.

meaning.id: Pekerjaan → tempat kerjanya.
meaning.en: Job → where it's done.

model_answer.id: Guru di sekolah, perawat di puskesmas, petani di sawah, dan nelayan di laut.
model_answer.en: Teachers at school, nurses at the puskesmas, farmers in the rice fields and fishers at sea.

meaning.id: Perutmu sakit di sekolah. Minta tolong ke siapa?
meaning.en: Your tummy hurts at school. Who do you ask?

text.en: A teacher or the UKS staff

model_answer.id: Guru atau petugas UKS akan membantu. Memberi tahu orang dewasa itu berani.
model_answer.en: A teacher or the UKS staff will help. Telling a grown-up is brave.

meaning.id: Pekerjaan dan alatnya.
meaning.en: Jobs and their tools.

model_answer.id: Petani: cangkul. Nelayan: jala. Dokter: stetoskop. Tukang kayu: gergaji.
model_answer.en: Farmer: hoe. Fisher: net. Doctor: stethoscope. Carpenter: saw.

meaning.id: Petugas kebersihan, satpam, dan penjaga kantin juga bagian dari keluarga besar sekolah.
meaning.en: Cleaners, security guards and canteen staff are part of the school community, too.

model_answer.id: Mereka menjaga sekolah aman, bersih, dan nyaman. Ucapkan terima kasih, ya.
model_answer.en: They keep school safe, clean and comfortable. Say thank you!

meaning.id: Di sekolah atau di sekitar rumah?
meaning.en: At school or around home?

model_answer.id: Di sekolah: guru kelas, petugas perpustakaan sekolah. Di sekitar rumah: Ketua RT, tukang sayur keliling.
model_answer.en: At school: the class teacher, the school librarian. Around home: the RT head, the travelling vegetable seller.

meaning.id: Orang yang bertugas menjaga keamanan sekolah disebut ____.
meaning.en: The person whose job is to keep the school safe is the ____.

model_answer.id: Satpam menjaga keamanan sekolah.
model_answer.en: The security guard keeps the school safe.

meaning.id: Pak RT menempel pengumuman kerja bakti. Di mana?
meaning.en: The RT head puts up a clean-up notice. Where?

model_answer.id: Pengumuman ditempel di papan pengumuman supaya semua warga bisa membacanya.
model_answer.en: Notices go on the noticeboard so all the neighbours can read them.

meaning.id: Apa yang sebaiknya Doni lakukan?
meaning.en: What would be best for Doni to do?

text.en: Play the drum as loudly as he can

text.id: Mengetuk pintu Bu Wati untuk mengajak mendengarkan
text.en: Knock on Bu Wati's door and invite them to listen

text.id: Menyimpan gendangnya dan bermain lagi besok siang
text.en: Put the drum away and play again tomorrow afternoon

model_answer.id: Bermain lagi besok siang, supaya bayi tetangga bisa tidur nyenyak.
model_answer.en: Play again tomorrow afternoon, so the baby next door can sleep.

meaning.id: Senang atau terganggu?
meaning.en: Happy or bothered?

text.en: Throwing rubbish into a neighbour's yard

model_answer.id: Senang: menyapa sambil tersenyum, membantu membawakan barang. Terganggu: membuang sampah ke halaman, berteriak malam.
model_answer.en: Happy: a smiling hello, helping carry things. Bothered: rubbish in their yard, shouting at night.

meaning.id: Gotong royong hanya untuk orang dewasa. Anak-anak tidak bisa ikut.
meaning.en: Gotong royong is only for grown-ups. Children can't join in.

model_answer.id: Anak-anak bisa ikut dengan cara kecil yang aman, misalnya memungut sampah plastik.
model_answer.en: Children can join in small, safe ways, like picking up plastic litter.

meaning.id: Kerja bakti: cara aman untuk membantu?
meaning.en: Clean-up day: a safe way to help?

text.en: Burning a pile of rubbish on your own

text.id: Membawakan air minum untuk yang bekerja
text.en: Bringing drinking water to the workers

model_answer.id: Membawakan air minum: aman dan berarti. Pekerjaan berbahaya untuk orang dewasa.
model_answer.en: Bringing drinking water: safe and useful. Risky jobs are for grown-ups.

meaning.id: Urutan kerja bakti.
meaning.en: The clean-up day, in order.

text.id: Warga berkumpul membawa sapu dan cangkul
text.en: Neighbours gather with brooms and hoes
The RT head announces the day
Clean the street and drains together

model_answer.id: Pengumuman, berkumpul, membersihkan bersama, lalu makan bersama.
model_answer.en: Announcement, gathering, cleaning together, then eating together.

meaning.id: Siapa yang bekerja menanam padi di sawah?
meaning.en: Who works planting rice in the rice fields?

model_answer.id: Petani menanam padi di sawah.
model_answer.en: Farmers plant rice in the rice fields.

meaning.id: Menolong tetangga membawa barang adalah contoh hidup rukun.
meaning.en: Helping a neighbour carry things is being a good neighbour.

model_answer.id: Saling menolong membuat hidup bertetangga rukun. Itulah semangat gotong royong.
model_answer.en: Helping each other keeps neighbours living happily together. That's the spirit of gotong royong.

items.source: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, "Indonesian Angklung" (Representative List, inscribed 2010; ich.unesco.org).

model_answer.id: Angklung, alat musik bambu dari Jawa Barat, masuk daftar Warisan Budaya Takbenda UNESCO pada 2010. Satu angklung biasanya membunyikan satu nada, jadi lagu dimainkan bersama: setiap orang menggoyangkan angklungnya pada gilirannya. Seperti gotong royong!
model_answer.en: The angklung, a bamboo instrument from West Java, joined UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2010. One angklung usually plays one note, so a song is played together: everyone shakes theirs on their turn. Just like gotong royong!

meaning.id: Kucing di kanan kotak.
meaning.en: The cat to the right of the box.

model_answer.id: Kucing duduk di sebelah kanan kotak, kalau kita melihat gambarnya.
model_answer.en: The cat is sitting to the right of the box, as you look at the picture.

meaning.id: Apa yang di kiri atas rumah?
meaning.en: What is up and to the left of the house?

model_answer.id: Matahari ada di sebelah kiri atas rumah. Layang-layang ada di sebelah kanan atas.
model_answer.en: The sun is up and to the left of the house. The kite is up and to the right.

meaning.id: Rani dan Budi berhadapan. Rani mengangkat tangan kanan. Dari Budi, tangan itu di sisi mana?
meaning.en: Rani and Budi face each other. Rani raises her right hand. For Budi, which side is it on?

model_answer.id: Di sisi kiri Budi. Coba praktikkan bersama temanmu!
model_answer.en: On Budi's left side. Try it with a friend!

meaning.id: Matahari di sebelah kiri rumah.
meaning.en: The sun is to the left of the house.

model_answer.id: Matahari ada di sebelah kiri rumah, sedangkan papan pengumuman ada di sebelah kanan.
model_answer.en: The sun is to the left of the house, and the noticeboard is to the right.

meaning.id: Apa yang tepat di bawah layang-layang?
meaning.en: What is right below the kite?

model_answer.id: Papan pengumuman ada tepat di bawah layang-layang.
model_answer.en: The noticeboard is right below the kite.

meaning.id: Dekat atau jauh dari rumah?
meaning.en: Near or far from home?

text.id: Rumah Nenek di kota lain, 5 jam naik bus
text.en: Grandma's house in another town, 5 hours by bus
The warung (small shop) at the end of the lane

text.id: Pantai di pulau lain, semalam naik kapal
text.en: A beach on another island, a night away by boat

model_answer.id: Dekat: rumah tetangga, warung, kamar mandi. Jauh: rumah Nenek di kota lain, pantai di pulau lain.
model_answer.en: Near: next door, the warung, your bathroom. Far: Grandma's in another town, a beach on another island.

meaning.id: Burung melihat rumah dari atas. Bagian apa yang paling banyak terlihat?
meaning.en: A bird looks down on the house. Which part does it see most?

model_answer.id: Atapnya. Karena itu, di peta rumah digambar sebagai kotak kecil.
model_answer.en: The roof. That's why a map shows a house as a small box.

meaning.id: Jalan kaki dari rumah Tono: sekolah 15 menit, warung 2 menit, lapangan 10 menit, pos ronda 5 menit. Mulai dari yang terdekat.
meaning.en: Walking from Tono's house: school 15 min, warung 2 min, field 10 min, watch post 5 min. Nearest first.

model_answer.id: Warung (2 menit), pos ronda (5 menit), lapangan (10 menit), lalu sekolah (15 menit).
model_answer.en: The warung (2 minutes), the neighbourhood watch post (5 minutes), the playing field (10 minutes), then school (15 minutes).

meaning.id: Simbol peta → artinya.
meaning.en: Map symbol → what it means.

model_answer.id: Kotak kecil: rumah. Garis biru berkelok: sungai. Dua garis sejajar: jalan. Pohon kecil: kebun atau hutan.
model_answer.en: Small square: house. Wiggly blue line: river. Two parallel lines: road. Tiny trees: garden or forest.

meaning.id: Gambar suatu tempat yang dilihat dari atas disebut ____.
meaning.en: A picture of a place seen from above is a ____.

model_answer.id: Peta adalah gambar suatu tempat yang dilihat dari atas.
model_answer.en: A map is a picture of a place seen from above.

model_answer.id: Buat peta kamarmu! Bayangkan kamu burung yang melihat kamarmu dari atas. Gambar kotak untuk kasur dan lemari, tandai pintu dan jendela, lalu buat keterangan kecil di pojok kertas. Tunjukkan petamu kepada keluargamu.
model_answer.en: Make a map of your room! Imagine you're a bird looking down on it. Draw boxes for the bed and cupboard, mark the door and window, then add a small key in the corner. Show your map to your family.

meaning.id: Kucing di kiri kotak.
meaning.en: The cat to the left of the box.

model_answer.id: Kucing duduk di sebelah kiri kotak, kalau kita melihat gambarnya.
model_answer.en: The cat is sitting to the left of the box, as you look at the picture.

meaning.id: Di peta, warung tepat di samping rumah Ayu; kantor pos di ujung lain. Mana yang lebih dekat?
meaning.en: On the map, the warung is right next to Ayu's house; the post office is at the far end. Which is nearer?

model_answer.id: Warung, karena di peta letaknya tepat di samping rumah Ayu.
model_answer.en: The warung: on the map it's right next to Ayu's house.

items.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Shen Kuo" (Mengxi bitan / Dream Pool Essays, 1088, describes the magnetic needle) and "compass (navigational instrument)" (britannica.com).

model_answer.id: Kompas adalah alat penunjuk arah. Lebih dari 900 tahun yang lalu, ilmuwan Tiongkok bernama Shen Kuo sudah menulis tentang jarum bermagnet yang selalu menunjuk ke arah utara dan selatan. Para pelaut lalu memakainya supaya tidak tersesat di laut.
model_answer.en: A compass shows us which way is which. More than 900 years ago, a Chinese scientist called Shen Kuo wrote about a magnetised needle that always points north and south. Sailors then used it so they would not get lost at sea.

meaning.id: Mana kelompok warna primer?
meaning.en: Which group shows the primary colours?

model_answer.id: Merah, kuning, dan biru adalah warna primer. Dari ketiganya kita bisa mencampur banyak warna lain.
model_answer.en: Red, yellow and blue are the primary colours. We can mix lots of other colours from them.

meaning.id: Campuran → hasilnya.
meaning.en: Mix → the colour it makes.

model_answer.id: Merah + kuning = jingga, kuning + biru = hijau, merah + biru = ungu, dan merah + putih = merah muda.
model_answer.en: Red + yellow = orange, yellow + blue = green, red + blue = purple, and red + white = pink.

meaning.id: Hijau adalah warna primer.
meaning.en: Green is a primary colour.

model_answer.id: Hijau adalah warna campuran: kuning ditambah biru.
model_answer.en: Green is a mixed colour: yellow plus blue.

meaning.id: Susun: merah + … = ungu.
meaning.en: Build it: red + … = purple.

model_answer.id: Merah + biru = ungu.
model_answer.en: Red + blue = purple.

meaning.id: Primer atau campuran?
meaning.en: Primary or mixed?

model_answer.id: Warna primer: merah, kuning, biru. Warna campuran: jingga, hijau, ungu.
model_answer.en: Primary colours: red, yellow, blue. Mixed colours: orange, green, purple.

meaning.id: Dodi mencampur cat kuning dan biru untuk daun. Jadinya ____.
meaning.en: Dodi mixes yellow and blue paint for a leaf. He gets ____.

model_answer.id: Kuning dan biru dicampur menjadi hijau, warna yang pas untuk daun.
model_answer.en: Yellow and blue mixed together make green, just right for a leaf.

meaning.id: Atap rumah sering digambar seperti ini.
meaning.en: House roofs are often drawn like this.

model_answer.id: Segitiga! Atap rumah sering digambar sebagai segitiga.
model_answer.en: A triangle! House roofs are often drawn as triangles.

meaning.id: Mana yang belah ketupat?
meaning.en: Which one is a rhombus (diamond)?

model_answer.id: Layang-layang itu berbentuk belah ketupat: empat sisinya sama panjang dan semuanya miring.
model_answer.en: The kite is a rhombus: four sides of the same length, all of them slanting.

meaning.id: Benda → bentuknya.
meaning.en: Thing → its shape.

model_answer.id: Roda: lingkaran. Pintu: persegi panjang. Telur: oval. Penggaris segitiga: segitiga.
model_answer.en: Wheel: circle. Door: rectangle. Egg: oval. Set square: triangle.

meaning.id: Rumah ini dibuat dari dua bentuk besar. Apa saja?
meaning.en: This house is made of two big shapes. Which ones?

model_answer.id: Atapnya segitiga, dindingnya persegi. Bentuk sederhana bisa menjadi gambar!
model_answer.en: A triangle roof and a square wall. Simple shapes make pictures!

model_answer.id: Buat roda warnamu! Gambar lingkaran besar dan bagi menjadi enam seperti potongan kue. Warnai berurutan: merah, jingga, kuning, hijau, biru, ungu. Tidak punya jingga, hijau, atau ungu? Campur dua warna primer. Minta orang dewasa membantu menyiapkan cat.
model_answer.en: Make your own colour wheel! Draw a big circle and divide it into six slices, like a cake. Colour them in order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple. No orange, green or purple? Mix two primary colours. Ask a grown-up to help set up the paints.

meaning.id: Merah + kuning jadi warna apa?
meaning.en: Red + yellow makes which colour?

model_answer.id: Merah dicampur kuning menjadi jingga.
model_answer.en: Red mixed with yellow makes orange.

meaning.id: Mana lingkaran?
meaning.en: Which one is a circle?

model_answer.id: Lingkaran itu bulat sempurna. Oval lebih lonjong, seperti telur.
model_answer.en: A circle is perfectly round. An oval is longer, like an egg.

items.source: Isaac Newton, Opticks (1704), Book I, Part II, Propositions III and VI (the spectrum and the colour circle divided like the notes of a musical octave).

model_answer.id: Ilmuwan Inggris Isaac Newton membagi warna pelangi menjadi tujuh: merah, jingga, kuning, hijau, biru, nila, dan ungu. Salah satu alasannya, ia membandingkan warna-warna itu dengan tujuh nada dalam musik. Warna dan bunyi ternyata bersaudara!
model_answer.en: The English scientist Isaac Newton split the rainbow into seven colours: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet. One of his reasons was that he compared the colours with the seven notes of a musical scale. Colour and sound turn out to be cousins!

meaning.id: Keras atau pelan?
meaning.en: Loud or soft?

text.en: A leaf falling to the ground
A crowd cheering at the field

model_answer.id: Keras: guntur, sirene, sorak penonton. Pelan: bisikan, daun jatuh.
model_answer.en: Loud: thunder, siren, cheering crowd. Soft: whisper, falling leaf.

meaning.id: Habis berlari, pegang dadamu. Detak jantungmu jadi …
meaning.en: After running, feel your chest. Your heartbeat becomes …

model_answer.id: Setelah berlari, jantung berdetak lebih cepat. Detak jantung juga punya irama!
model_answer.en: After running, your heart beats faster. Your heartbeat has a rhythm, too!

meaning.id: Dari yang paling pelan.
meaning.en: Softest first.

model_answer.id: Bisikan, orang bercakap-cakap, teriakan, lalu guntur yang menggelegar.
model_answer.en: A whisper, people chatting, a shout, then a crash of thunder.

meaning.id: Bunyi terlalu keras bisa menyakiti bagian ini.
meaning.en: Very loud sounds can hurt this part.

model_answer.id: Telinga. Kalau ada bunyi yang terlalu keras, tutup telingamu atau menjauhlah.
model_answer.en: Your ears. If a sound is too loud, cover your ears or move away.

meaning.id: Lagu pengantar tidur, seperti "Nina Bobo", biasanya dinyanyikan dengan cepat dan keras.
meaning.en: Lullabies such as "Nina Bobo" are usually sung fast and loud.

model_answer.id: Lagu pengantar tidur dinyanyikan pelan dan lambat supaya adik tenang.
model_answer.en: Lullabies are sung softly and slowly so little ones feel calm.

meaning.id: Bu Guru menurunkan tangannya rendah sekali. Bagaimana anak-anak sebaiknya bermain?
meaning.en: The teacher lowers her hand right down. How should the children play?

model_answer.id: Tangan Bu Guru turun rendah, jadi anak-anak bermain dengan pelan.
model_answer.en: The teacher's hand is down low, so the children play softly.

meaning.id: Aba-aba: hentak kaki sekali, tepuk sekali, lalu diam.
meaning.en: The call: stamp once, clap once, then rest.

model_answer.id: Hentak kaki – tepuk tangan – diam.
model_answer.en: Stamp – clap – rest.

meaning.id: Satu tepukan untuk setiap suku kata. Berapa tepukan untuk "kupu-kupu" (ku-pu-ku-pu)?
meaning.en: One clap per syllable. How many claps for "kupu-kupu" (butterfly): ku-pu-ku-pu?

model_answer.id: Ku-pu-ku-pu: empat suku kata, jadi empat tepukan.
model_answer.en: Ku-pu-ku-pu: four syllables, so four claps.

meaning.id: Lanjutkan polanya: tepuk – tepuk – diam – tepuk – tepuk – diam – tepuk – ____
meaning.en: Carry on the pattern: clap – clap – rest – clap – clap – rest – clap – ____

model_answer.id: Pola "tepuk – tepuk – diam" diulang terus, jadi setelah satu tepuk datang tepuk kedua.
model_answer.en: The pattern "clap – clap – rest" keeps repeating, so after one clap comes a second clap.

meaning.id: Diam di antara tepukan juga bagian dari irama.
meaning.en: The quiet moments between claps are part of the rhythm, too.

model_answer.id: Jeda membuat pola terdengar jelas; tanpa jeda, tepukan menyatu.
model_answer.en: Rests make the pattern clear; without them, the claps run together.

model_answer.id: Buat pola tepukmu sendiri! Pakai tepuk tangan, hentak kaki, dan diam, misalnya "tepuk – hentak – diam". Ajak keluargamu menirukannya. Mainkan pelan lalu keras, lambat lalu cepat.
model_answer.en: Make up your own clapping pattern! Use claps, stamps and rests, like "clap – stamp – rest". Ask your family to copy it. Play it soft then loud, slow then fast.

meaning.id: Lanjutkan polanya: tepuk – diam – tepuk – diam – tepuk – ____
meaning.en: Carry on the pattern: clap – rest – clap – rest – clap – ____

model_answer.id: Polanya "tepuk – diam" berganti-ganti, jadi setelah tepuk datang diam.
model_answer.en: The pattern "clap – rest" takes turns, so after a clap comes a rest.

meaning.id: Menidurkan adik bayi. Bernyanyi seperti apa?
meaning.en: Singing the baby to sleep. How should you sing?

model_answer.id: Pelan dan lambat, supaya adik bayi tenang dan bisa tidur.
model_answer.en: Softly and slowly, so the baby feels calm and can fall asleep.

items.source: Museum Sumpah Pemuda, Kemendikbudristek (museumsumpahpemuda.kemdikbud.go.id), on W.R. Supratman and the Second Youth Congress; UU No. 24 Tahun 2009 (Indonesia Raya composed by Wage Rudolf Supratman).

model_answer.id: Lagu "Indonesia Raya" pertama kali diperdengarkan oleh penciptanya, W.R. Supratman, dengan biola pada Kongres Pemuda II, 28 Oktober 1928. Waktu itu lagunya dimainkan tanpa dinyanyikan.
model_answer.en: "Indonesia Raya" was first heard when its composer, W.R. Supratman, played it on the violin at the Second Youth Congress on 28 October 1928. That day it was played without the words being sung.

meaning.id: Aku ibu dari ayahmu. Siapa aku?
meaning.en: I am your dad's mother. Who am I?

model_answer.id: Nenek!
model_answer.en: Your grandmother (Nenek)!

meaning.id: Saat kerja bakti, anak-anak dibagi menjadi 3 kelompok. Setiap kelompok ada 4 anak. Berapa anak semuanya?
meaning.en: At the clean-up day, the children make 3 groups with 4 children in each. How many children are there altogether?

model_answer.en: 3 × 4 = 12 children.

meaning.id: Pola tepuk Sari: tepuk – tepuk – diam. Ia mengulang polanya 3 kali. Berapa kali Sari bertepuk tangan?
meaning.en: Sari's pattern is clap – clap – rest. She plays it 3 times. How many times does Sari clap?

model_answer.id: Sari bertepuk 2 kali dalam setiap pola. 3 × 2 = 6 tepukan.
model_answer.en: Sari claps twice in each pattern. 3 × 2 = 6 claps.
